name: mtevent_split_v2
why: v1 leaked scenes 10/21/23 into both train and val, had no held-out wooden_pallet (all 551 val pallet instances were in leaked scene 21), and its test split was 2 scenes with corrupt labels. v2: every scene in exactly one split, every class has >=2 train scenes and >=1 val scene, pallet held out in BOTH val and test.
rules: disjoint: each of the 75 MTevent scenes appears in exactly one split
every class 0..16 has >=2 train scenes and >=1 val scene
wooden_pallet (class 0, only 6 scenes: 17 18 21 52 55 72) -> train 17/52/55, val 18/21, test 72
